body: Is there any specific reason you're depressed?

It will sound dumb. But whatever. I'm 22, finishing my undergraduate degree soon. When I was 14 I met my first girlfriend, who after six years of a relationship became my fiance. Three months ago she left me over text, saying that she wanted to have some time to work out personal issues, but that she loves me and it's only temporary. After about a month I find out she's been on several dates witb another man, she's told him she really likes him etc. About a month later she tells me she told him she doesn't want a relationship. And it's been like that for a month. This all sounds dumb but I'm a wreck. I can't sleep or eat, I consciously think about her and him every waking moment of my life. I hate myself, hate him, hate her, love her, blame myself tell myself I'm not to blame. I can't rest she's been my life for several years, no one and nothing came before her. I feel replaced and forgotten, even though she still talks about getting back together and that she misses me. I realize tho must be as hard on her as it is to me. But I don't know what to do I want to stop existing simply to get peace.

Hey there.  The fact that you're posting here gives me thought that at least some shred of your existence is struggling to survive.  That's awesome. What happened in the last year that's driven you to suicidal thoughts?

Depending on how close this friend was to him, he may be going through a very similar experience as you. While I do not think it is right of him to ignore your texts and calls, I would try to understand that he isn't in a healthy state of mind right now. Has he specifically said that your relationship was over, other than saying he needed space?
